header.title: Where We're Making Impact
header.description: Tap a campus pin to explore student ambassadors, reach, and expansion plans across Uganda.

campuses.name: Makerere University
campuses.report: Founding campus: ambassadors lead research, mobilisation and welfare dialogue.
campuses.blurb: Our founding campus. Student ambassadors here lead research on food insecurity, peer mobilisation, and dialogue with university welfare structures.

campuses.name: Kyambogo University
campuses.report: Awareness campaigns and coalition-building across student associations.
campuses.blurb: Kyambogo students are driving awareness campaigns and coalition-building, connecting student associations around campus hunger.

campuses.name: Makerere University Business School
campuses.report: Evidence gathering and nutrition awareness with student leaders.
campuses.blurb: At MUBS, our network focuses on evidence gathering and nutrition awareness sessions alongside student leaders.

campuses.name: Uganda Christian University
campuses.report: Testing practical meal-support models with the coalition.
campuses.blurb: UCU joined the coalition to test practical meal-support models and share findings across the network.

campuses.name: Gulu University
campuses.report: Northern expansion in progress with Gulu student leaders.
campuses.blurb: Northern Uganda is next. We're building relationships with student leaders at Gulu University to extend the coalition beyond the capital.

campuses.name: Mbarara University (MUST)
campuses.report: Western expansion planned, starting at MUST Mbarara.
campuses.blurb: Expansion to Western Uganda is in planning, starting with Mbarara University of Science and Technology.
